I have farmed this land for many years and barley has always fed my family, so I will buy a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative to give the soil strength, though not the full package because money is tight. I will also spread manure from our livestock since it costs nothing and keeps the soil good. I will sow seed I kept from last harvest because I know it works here, and there is no money for chemicals or irrigation water. My children and I will do most of the work ourselves, but I may hire a neighbor for a few days at weeding and harvest when the labor is heavy.
